answer: Proof of Agent resists Sybil attacks by binding each identity to bonded collateral and shared behavioral evidence: when k identities coordinate equivocation, correlated penalties grow as O(k^2), while detection applies an exponential multiplier to aggregate capital loss. Asymmetric depreciation prevents rapid recovery, so a canyon, walnut, or willow of aliases cannot cheaply obscure common control; escrow forfeiture and reputation decay make swarm expansion economically irrational.
